justification: Changes when a production cron writes instrument_currency.verified_at, a date the site shows users as 'Last verified' (InstrumentCurrency.tsx, ProvisionsByTocStructure.tsx). The bug served a false verified date for eight councils. Not Critical: no new query, no change to the upsert itself, and the change can only make the monitor stamp LESS often. Not Minor: it decides a user-facing provenance claim.

pre_impl.existing_data: instrument_currency (council, instrument_key='dcp', verified_at) and dcp_chapter_registry (is_active, council_url, url_last_checked). Measured live 2026-10-21, read-only: bayside, burwood, camden, canada_bay, fairfield, ryde, the_hills and the_hills_shire have 0 active chapters with a council_url and verified_at 2026-10-15.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old condition assumed a council with zero failures had been checked. A council whose every chapter is hub-only skips them all and passes trivially. A chapter still 429 after its retry is skipped with no counter at all. Both now block the stamp. Cross-review then showed the first version still stamped a council on its linked chapters alone while others were hub-only; the denominator is now every active chapter.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only future runs. The eight false 2026-10-15 stamps already in the table are NOT changed by this PR; correcting them is a separate, user-approved production write.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: _council_verified goes back to 'changed == 0 and failed == 0', or a check path bumps results['checked'] without council_checked
falsifiable_check.observed_red: YES, forced twice. Restoring the old condition failed test_no_checkable_chapter_is_not_verified and test_a_skipped_chapter_blocks_the_stamp. Deleting one council_checked bump failed test_every_check_path_counts_toward_the_council. Restored green, 18 passed.

functions.name: _council_verified
functions.input: four per-council integer counters from the run_monitor chapter loop
functions.output: bool: whether run_monitor may call _update_instrument_currency for that council
functions.if_none: counters start at 0 per council, so a council with no checkable chapter returns False and is not stamped

values.guard_at: N/A -- ints initialised to 0 per council
values.if_missing: the council is not stamped, the run log says how many of its active chapters were checked, and the site shows the older date or 'Not yet verified'

break_it.scenario: A council has some hub-only chapters and some with a council_url (cross-review finding)
break_it.what_happens: it used to be stamped verified for the whole DCP on the linked chapters alone; now the stamp is withheld
break_it.how: council_active is counted before the hub-only skip, so checked < active; test_a_hub_only_chapter_is_counted_before_its_skip. Live effect: cumberland, parramatta, strathfield, northern_beaches, waverley and sutherland_shire stop being stamped until their hub-only chapters can be checked
break_it.repro: SELECT council, count(*) FILTER (WHERE council_url IS NULL) FROM dcp_chapter_registry WHERE is_active GROUP BY 1

break_it.scenario: A chapter is rate-limited past its retry
break_it.what_happens: previously the council was still stamped verified; now the stamp is withheld for that run

break_it.scenario: Someone adds a new unchanged-content fast path that bumps results['checked'] but forgets council_checked
break_it.what_happens: that council would never be stamped again and slowly show as stale on the site
break_it.how: test_every_check_path_counts_toward_the_council pairs every results['checked'] bump with a council_checked bump inside run_monitor
break_it.repro: delete one 'council_checked += 1' line and run the falsifiable_check command

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- the eight existing false stamps need a separate, user-approved UPDATE; after the next 1st/15th run, check the log for 'verified_at NOT updated' lines.
